name: Pure Hearts
summary: In the Undercity, Pure Hearts draw a succubus from the Twisting Nether. Carendin Halgar gives these ritual reagents to Forsaken warlocks, who use them to manifest the demon and attempt to defeat and bind her.

sections.title: Bait for the Nether
sections.body: Carendin Halgar gives Pure Hearts to warlocks who summon a succubus in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Set on the summoning circle, these untainted spiritual essences lure the demon across the Twisting Nether and into the mortal realm. Once she appears, the warlock must resist her enthralling mind-charms and strike her down. Defeating the succubus asserts mystical dominance and sends her back to the Twisting Nether. Carendin then teaches the warlock the spell to summon her at will.

faq.q: What are the Pure Hearts used for?
faq.answer: Pure Hearts lure a succubus across the Twisting Nether and manifest her in the mortal realm, at the summoning circle in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where a warlock can fight and bind her.
Carendin Halgar, a Forsaken warlock trainer in the Undercity, gives Pure Hearts to warlocks preparing to summon a succubus.

faq.q: Why does a succubus respond to Pure Hearts?
faq.answer: Succubi thrive on corruption and seduction, and the radiance of unblemished hearts is an irresistible lure across the Twisting Nether, drawing them to a warlock's summoning circle.

faq.q: Do you get to keep the Pure Hearts after the ritual?
faq.answer: No. After the succubus is summoned and subdued, the Pure Hearts' remnants go back to Carendin Halgar as proof that the binding trial is complete.

angles.text: As a warlock, using Pure Hearts marks a turning point in demonology and proves your mental strength against the Twisting Nether's seductive lures.
As an Undead, you use untainted hearts to manipulate demonic appetites. This cold, pragmatic sorcery exemplifies Forsaken practice.
